_what_this_does_not_claim: Coverage of the whole guard population. The registry is authoritative for what it CONTAINS and says nothing about what it omits. Enumerating 'every guard' by any literal -- a name pattern, a `raise` spelling, a decorator -- is the same defect in a new costume. Completeness is a review obligation, not a check here.
_why_dispatcher: All three settled vacuous-guard instances are in orchestration code; zero are under platform/. A meta-test in platform/tests/ would have covered none of them.
_who_runs_these: This harness, from dispatcher/, where pytest execution is available. The OpenCode vp-builder sandbox denies pytest in every spelling (D88), so a builder can never produce this evidence -- which is why packet-side controls ship as pre-run logs in the packet directory and are copied in by D116.

guards.why: D117/§136: an open pipeline may be re-polled for an ask only when it ran the SAME thing. Without it one scoped set is adopted for another -- five siblings adopted one twin's pipeline in a single day -- and a row is then graded on a measurement of different files.

controls.edit: the twin-adopts-full clause returns True unconditionally, so any open record answers any ask
